_meta.note: UMN Twin Cities official 2024-25 CDS has blank C11/C21 counts. SLU has no current public CDS found; loaded its official 2021-22 CDS GPA distribution as legacy official fallback.

schools.notes: Official UMN Twin Cities 2024-25 CDS leaves C11 GPA rows blank with 0.00 totals and no GPA-submitted percentage. C21/C22 indicate early plans but do not publish applicant/admit counts, so no ED/EA rate can be calculated.

Official SLU 2021-22 CDS C11: 4.0=50.56%, 3.75-3.99=19.79%, 3.50-3.74=12.10%, 3.25-3.49=7.64%, 3.00-3.24=4.74%, 2.50-2.99=4.57%, 2.0-2.49=0.61%. C21/C22 list early plans but no applicant/admit counts for a calculable rate. This is a legacy official fallback because no public current CDS was found.
